key_insight: ScaleWorld uses one shared video model to predict low-resolution scenes and refine them into high-resolution world videos. This avoids the need for a separate refinement model.
problem_solved: Direct high-resolution video generation demands substantial computation and memory, making detailed world-model outputs costly to produce.
method: Use a causal video model to predict world videos at low resolution.
Refine the model’s own predictions to add high-resolution scene structures and textures.
Share a single backbone between prediction and refinement rather than using separate models.
impact: ScaleWorld offers a unified approach to detailed world-video generation that could simplify model deployment. The supplied abstract is incomplete, so specific efficiency gains and quality improvements cannot be assessed.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: low-resolution prediction → shared-backbone refinement → high-resolution video.
Before-and-after scene crops highlighting finer structures and textures.
Architecture comparison: separate prediction and refinement models versus one shared backbone.
Compute and memory icons illustrating the cost challenge of direct high-resolution generation.
paper_title: ScaleWorld: High-Resolution World Generation through Shared Prediction and Refinement
paper_authors: Yansong Qu, Wesker Zheng, Quanjian Song, Zhiyuan Zhang, Xiao Cao
